title: The second reader does not pay the model
blurb: The other half of the highest-leverage cache in the system. The fetch cache stopped the second reader paying somebody else’s server and left every model call in place — sixteen of them for linear.app, counted by landscape cost without asking a model. An extraction is now remembered against the page’s own text, so an edited page is a new question rather than a stale answer, and a run that failed or that nobody waited for is never remembered at all.
